description: This file implements a health monitoring service for agent nodes, including registration, health checks via HTTP, status updates, MCP health tracking, and recovery from database. It manages active agents, performs periodic health checks, and integrates with a unified status system or falls back to legacy updates.

classes.name: HealthMonitorConfig
classes.description: Configuration settings for the health monitor, primarily check interval duration.

classes.name: ActiveAgent
classes.description: Represents an actively monitored agent with its node ID, base URL, last known status, and last checked timestamp.

classes.name: HealthMonitor
classes.description: Main service class managing agent health checks, registration, status updates, MCP health tracking, and recovery.

methods.name: NewHealthMonitor
methods.description: Constructor function to initialize a new HealthMonitor instance with default check interval if not specified.

methods.name: RegisterAgent
methods.description: Adds an agent to the active monitoring list and updates presence.

methods.name: UnregisterAgent
methods.description: Removes an agent from monitoring, updates status to inactive, and broadcasts offline events.

methods.name: RecoverFromDatabase
methods.description: Loads previously registered agents from storage and performs initial health checks on startup.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins periodic health checks at configured intervals.

methods.name: checkActiveAgents
methods.description: Performs health checks on all registered active agents.

methods.name: checkAgentHealth
methods.description: Performs an HTTP health check for a specific agent, updates status, and triggers MCP health checks if active.

methods.name: checkMCPHealthForNode
methods.description: Fetches and updates MCP health status for a specific node, broadcasting changes.

methods.name: hasMCPHealthChanged
methods.description: Determines if MCP health data has changed for a node compared to cached data.

methods.name: updateMCPHealthCache
methods.description: Updates the cached MCP health data for a node.

methods.name: GetMCPHealthCache
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current MCP health cache for monitoring or debugging.
